transcript: My name is Isaru Dishanake, and I'm preparing for a full stack developer role. I have hand non-practice with React, Node.js, and MySQL. better_answer_example: I'd like to give an example of how I used React to build a user-friendly interface for our sales dashboard. My main contribution was creating sales reports that helped our business identify trends and make data-driven decisions.
